facts.material: aluminum alloy (about 91% by weight) with stainless steel hardware
facts.function: additional rider footrests mounted to the motorcycle frame
facts.form: kit of two model-specific footpegs with mounting hardware

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8714 parts and accessories of vehicles of headings 8711 to 8713; Section XVII notes checked (not excluded as a general metal part of Section XV, since they are identifiable motorcycle parts)

rejected_alternatives.reason: general aluminum articles; Section XVII note 2(f) excludes parts of vehicles

classification.rationale: G88285 treated a motorcycle highway peg (footrest) kit as a motorcycle accessory under heading 8714 (its old suffix 8714.19.0060 is obsolete; the current line for other parts of motorcycles is 8714.10.00.50).
